request: The Great Wall, whole level: Lara is standing at the level's start. Please play the whole level through to its end, until the level-complete statistics screen has shown and the next level (Venice) starts loading. Play naturally: pick up everything you normally would, fight the enemies, use the zipline, and so on. Please don't save to the memory card or open the passport's Load/Save (the port has no card screens); the inventory ring is fine (medipacks etc). Quick save/load (F5/F7) is fine, it's cut out of the replay. Press F12 when the next level starts loading.
